text: {"lessons":["I should judge progress by my holdings, cash, and investment plan—not account-value changes alone, which don’t tell me what drove the result.","Adding to a stock at a higher price can increase concentration; before buying more, I should check how much of my account is already exposed to it.","Because I have a ten-year goal, I should make measured decisions based on my plan rather than trying to speed up growth with frequent or reactive trades."]}
